name: Brainattic
description: EU-hosted knowledge base for AI agents with hybrid semantic and keyword search, versioned documents, and permission-controlled reading and editing. Brainattic account and OAuth 2.1 sign-in required (PKCE and DCR); no API key. Endpoint: `https://app.brainattic.ai/api/mcp` · Registry: `ai.brainattic/knowledge-base`
